source_metadata.tag_capture_note: Observed counts describe stored graph attributes. Tags absent from an older cache may have been omitted at acquisition; they are not proof that the street has no such feature.
source_metadata.limitation: Pedestrian network and accessibility tags are OpenStreetMap data, not a complete or field-verified sidewalk inventory.

sampling: SHA256 ordering v1, 150 nodes per stop, excluding stop node

inspections.method: Top 12 unknown physical segments by occurrence on deterministic shortest possible sample paths; then exact single-candidate blocked-versus-usable reachability within the time budget.
inspections.parallel_edge_policy: An OSM way plus unordered endpoint pair identifies one physical candidate; both mapped directions are blocked together. Distinct OSM ways remain alternatives.

candidates.assumptions: Directed travel toward each stop; walk_seconds includes the selected profile cost. Other unknown connections remain usable in both hypothetical scenarios. Counts describe sampled graph journeys, not people, ridership, safety or official priority.
